answer: Because the mesa pair is tracked in the fable ledger, the copper audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 159 identities means 159 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Full reward presupposes answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 21%. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
